# FDG7043

> DO set the `ParamName` property when throwing one of the subclasses of `ArgumentExceptions`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.3.4 ArgumentException, ArgumentNullException, and ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA2208
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

CA2208 reports an argument exception created without a parameter name, a parameter name that is not a parameter of the method (the body's nameof(path) passes), and reversed message and parameter name arguments. It does not report ArgumentException(string message), which has no parameter name, so coverage is partial. Its code fix only swaps reversed arguments. The setter case is FDG7044.

## From the book

This property represents the name of the parameter that caused the exception to be thrown. Note that the property can be set using one of the constructor overloads.

```csharp
public static FileAttributes GetAttributes(string path){
  if(path==null){
    throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(path),...);
  }
}
```
